# archestra_role (Data Source)

Finds a predefined or custom role by its exact display name, for example one created in the UI. Use `role` wherever a role identifier is expected, such as the `role` of a service account. Granular roles are not listed: use their identifier, such as `fixed:agents:reader`, directly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Give a service account a custom role created in the UI, by its name.
data "archestra_role" "release_managers" {
  name = "Release managers"
}

resource "archestra_service_account" "release_bot" {
  name = "release-bot"
  role = data.archestra_role.release_managers.role
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact display name of the role.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) What the role grants.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `predefined` (Boolean) Whether the role is predefined rather than custom.
- `role` (String) Role identifier.
